summary: Aura Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, furnishing a press release with preliminary Q3 2026 and nine-month production results from its six operating mines: Aranzazu, Apoena, Minosa, Almas, Borborema, and MSG. Q3 production reached a record 95,557 gold equivalent ounces, up 27% quarter-over-quarter and 29% year-over-year; nine-month output of 253,131 GEO rose 26% at constant prices. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation; monitor production trends and guidance execution.
